name: bare-wasi

extraSections.heading: Capabilities
extraSections.body:
Every resource a guest can reach is passed in by the embedder:

- **Streams.** Standard input, output, and error exist only if `stdin`, `stdout`, and `stderr` are given.
- **Directories.** A guest can only reach the directories given as `preopens`, and paths are resolved by `bare-wasi` itself, one name at a time. Absolute paths, symbolic links that point outside of a directory, and `..` beyond where a lookup started all fail with `ENOTCAPABLE`.
- **Clocks.** Clocks are available by default, as they are to any JavaScript, and can be denied with `clock: null`.
- **Randomness.** `random_get` fails with `ENOTCAPABLE` unless a `random` function is given.

Beyond these, a guest only sees the arguments and environment variables it is given. There are no sockets.

extraSections.heading: Conformance
extraSections.body: `bare-wasi` passes the WASI preview 1 tests of the [WASI test suite](https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-testsuite), which are fetched at a pinned commit and run as part of `npm test`. Tests that are known to fail are listed with the reason in [`test/suite.json`](test/suite.json), and a listed test that starts passing fails the run.

exports.name: WASI
exports.description:
A capability based implementation of WASI preview 1 for a single WebAssembly
instance. The instance can only reach the streams, directories, clocks, and
randomness it is given.

members.description:
Initialize a reactor instance by calling its `_initialize()` export, if it

members.description:

its `memory` and must not export `_initialize()`, and an implementation
may only be used with a single instance.

returns.description:

exports.name: WASIOptions
signatures:
interface WASIOptions {
  version: 'preview1'
  args?: string[]
  env?: Record<string, string>
  preopens?: Record<string, WASIDirectory>
  stdin?: string | Uint8Array | WASIReadable | WASIFile | null
  stdout?: ((data: Uint8Array) => void) | WASIWritable | WASIFile | null
  stderr?: ((data: Uint8Array) => void) | WASIWritable | WASIFile | null
  clock?: WASIClock | null
  random?: ((buffer: Uint8Array) => void) | null
  returnOnExit?: boolean
}
exports.description: The capabilities granted to an instance, none of which are granted by default except clocks.

members.name: args
members.description: The arguments of the program, including its name. Defaults to `[]`.

members.name: clock
members.description:
The clocks of the program, or `null` to deny access to clocks, which then
fail with `ENOTCAPABLE`. Defaults to the clocks of the host.

members.name: env
members.description: The environment variables of the program. Defaults to `{}`.

members.name: preopens
members.description:
The directories made available to the program, keyed by the path the
program sees each of them at. Defaults to `{}`.

members.name: random
members.description:
A function that fills `buffer` with cryptographically secure random bytes,
or `null` to deny access to randomness, which then fails with
`ENOTCAPABLE`. Defaults to `null`.

members.name: returnOnExit
members.description:
Whether `start()` returns the exit code of the program rather than
exiting the process with it. Defaults to `true`.

members.name: stderr
signatures: stderr: ((data: Uint8Array) => void) | WASIWritable | WASIFile | null
members.description:
The standard error of the program, given in the same ways as `stdout`.
Standard error does not exist if `null`, which is the default.

members.name: stdin
signatures: stdin: string | Uint8Array | WASIReadable | WASIFile | null
members.description:
The standard input of the program, given as its contents, as a source to
read from, or as a file. Standard input does not exist if `null`, which is
the default.

members.name: stdout
signatures: stdout: ((data: Uint8Array) => void) | WASIWritable | WASIFile | null
members.description:
The standard output of the program, given as a function called with each
write, as a destination to write to, or as a file. Standard output does
not exist if `null`, which is the default.

members.name: version
members.description:
The version of WASI that the options are written for, which must be
`'preview1'`. Required, as in Node.js.

exports.name: WASINode
exports.description:
A node of a filesystem backend. Backends are synchronous and report failures
by throwing errors whose `code` is a POSIX error name, such as `'ENOENT'`,
which is passed on to the guest as the corresponding WASI error.

A directory of a filesystem backend. Every operation takes a single name
rather than a path, as paths are resolved by the WASI implementation itself.
Names are never empty, `.`, or `..`, and never contain `/` or NUL.

exports.name: HostDirectory
exports.description:
A host directory backed by a `bare-directory` capability. The guest reaches
only what the capability reaches, with its rights, and `bare-wasi` resolves
symbolic links within the preopen. On Windows, link targets use `/` as the
separator and drive letter, UNC, and device paths are absolute.

Files are opened when looked up, with the most access the rights and the file
allow, so an open file stays the same file if it's renamed. Creating symbolic
and hard links isn't supported, and renaming into a directory of another
backend fails with `EXDEV`.

params.name: directory
params.description: The `bare-directory` capability to expose to the guest.
